description_en: Within the Bālakumārī pīṭha located in Cā Bāhāḥ tole, Lalitpur—generally considered to have been established during the Licchavi period—an installation of Ṣoḍaśī, one of the Daśamahāvidyās, is also enshrined. Bālakumārī is established at four locations in Lalitpur. Among these, the Bālakumārī pīṭha situated along the roadside immediately north of Jyābā Bahī (LAL2610) in Cā Bāhāḥ tole is regarded as the principal Bālakumārī of Lalitpur. This west-facingpīṭhais covered with a copper roof surmounted by three metal gajūras, each crowned with a metal chatra, and further ornamented with a metalpatāḥ. Enshrined within the pīṭha is an aniconic stone representing Bālakumārī, fitted with a metal toraṇa. Behind this stone stands another metal toraṇa bearing representations of the Mātṛkās; within thegavākṣaof this rear toraṇa is a Licchavi-period caitya. Additional aniconic stones representing Gaṇeśa, Vārāhī, and other Mātṛkās are also installed within thepīṭha.Adjacent to the Bālakumārī stone on its northern side is another stone, a portion of which is venerated as Ṣoḍaśī, also known as Tripurasundarī. According to textual descriptions, Ṣoḍaśī is depicted as three-eyed, seated upon a lotus throne placed atop a reclining Sadāśiva, and holding apāśa,aṅkuśa,dhanus, andvāṇain her four hands (N. Pokharela 2019, p. 53). Full-moon day of Māgha is regarded as her birth anniversary (J. Mānaṅdhara VS 2046, p. 33). It is believed that worship of Ṣoḍaśī with offerings of bananas, grapes, jujube fruits, sweets, and red cloth alleviates poverty (M. Miśra NS 1127, p. 18).In front of thepīṭhastand a stone pillar topped with a bronze peacock and a Śivaliṅga of Śaṅkhareśvara Mahādeva. Although no historical document explicitly records the original foundation of the Bālakumārī Pīṭha, the presence of a Licchavi caitya within it strongly suggests that the pīṭha was already established during the Licchavi period. Local belief holds that this form of Bālakumārī was once extremely fierce, frightening travelers and causing illness; to pacify her ferocity, a caitya was installed alongside her, which remains visible within the pīṭha.Oral tradition further recounts that tantric practitioners from Thimi attempted to transport this Bālakumārī to their own locality. Upon reaching Sundhārā, soil is said to have fallen from the goddess’s body, prompting them to rest briefly; at that spot, another Bālakumārī pīṭha (LAL4044-003) was established in front of Lakṣmīnārāyaṇa Sataḥ (LAL4044). When they later halted at Tyāgal, a Bālakumārīdyāḥcheṃ(LAL2140) was founded there as well. After reaching Kwāchẽ, where a rooster crowed at dawn, the carriers are said to have abandoned the goddess, returning without her. Consequently, a Bālakumārī pīṭha was established at Kwāchẽ, which was later transformed into a tiered-style temple known as the Bālakumārī Temple (LAL2000). Following their failure to bring the Lalitpur Bālakumārī to Thimi, the tantric practitioners are said to have installed a replica Bālakumārī in Thimi (THI0010) (Local resident from a Śreṣṭha caste, male, age 62). The present location of the Bālakumārī pīṭha was formerly a cremation ground (masān); the place where ashes were heaped after cremation is still known asNaudvaṃ, situated to the east of the pīṭha. The cremation ground associated with the pīṭha was later relocated to Kwāchẽ.The earliest inscription found at the site is a stone inscription dated 1696 CE (NS 817). It records that Mahān (sipāhī) Bilhāma Bhāro, together with his sons Siddhirāma and Praśurāma (Paraśurāma), his daughter Sarasuti (Sarasvatī), and his grandson Kṛṣṇarāma, performed ayajñaand established Kumārī (Bālakumārī) and Vighneśvara (Gaṇeśa). Since thepīṭhamust have existed well before this date, this act likely constituted a renovation and ritual reinstallation rather than an original foundation. In 1717 CE (NS 837), Yajñanārāyaṇa Bhāju, Gaṅgādhara Bhāro, Dhanasiṃ, Cikudhika, and others jointly donated a pair of stone lions to thepīṭha. In 1897 CE (VS 1953), Mukhiya Puṇyarāja, son of Sidhimāna Śreṣṭha of Cā Bāhāla tole, Lalitpur, together with his family, donated the stone pillar with a peacock and a bell. In 1925 CE (VS 1981), a brasstoraṇawas installed for the Gaṇeśa shrine within thepīṭha, though the donor’s name recorded in the accompanying inscription has since been erased. On 10 April 2010 CE (VS 2066 Caitra 10, Tuesday; NS 1130 Chulathva 8), akṣamāpūjāwas performed to commence construction works through which the previously open roadsidepīṭhawas roofed and enclosed on all sides for protection.No separate priest is appointed specifically for the Bālakumārī Pīṭha. Daily worship (nityapūjā) is conducted by a member of the Śāhī lineage serving asdyāḥpāḥlāḥ, who also performs daily cleaning of the shrine in the morning. Every Saturday morning, a metal image of Bālakumārī seated on a peacock is brought out and displayed; on other days, this image is kept in thedyāḥpāḥlāḥ’s house. Each year on 14th of bright fortnight of Bhādra, a Bālakumārī Procession is held, organized by the Maharjana community of Cā Bāhāḥ tole. On that morning, a buffalo is sacrificed to Bālakumārī, and in the evening the metal images of Bālakumārī, Gaṇeśa, and Vārāhī are carried by hand in procession. After thejātrā, these images are taken to the house of theguthiyāra.The Ṣoḍaśī enshrined within the pīṭha receives a separate daily worship. Thisnityapūjāis performed by a Rājopādhyāya Brahmin, with remuneration arranged by an organization known as the “Daśamahāvidyā Bhaktibhāva Parivāra.” Previously, there was no provision for daily worship of Ṣoḍaśī; this practice began only on 8 October 2023 CE (VS 2080 Bhādra 22) (Priest of Pūrṇacaṇḍī Temple from the Rājopādhyāya caste, male, age 74). Each year, during the collective worship of the Daśamahāvidyās held in Lalitpur on Kāyāṣṭamī (Bhādra Śukla 8), Ṣoḍaśī enshrined within the Bālakumārī pīṭha is also duly worshipped.
description_ne: लिच्छविकालमै स्थापना भएको मानिने चा बाहाःमा टोलमा रहेको बालकुमारी पीठभित्र दशमहाविद्यामध्यकी एक षोडशी पनि स्थापना गरिएको छ ।ललितपुरका चार स्थानमा बालकुमारी स्थापना गरिएका छन् । ती बालकुमारीमध्ये चा बाहाः टोलमा ज्याबा बही (LAL2610) को उत्तरपट्टि बाटोको छेउमा बालकुमारी पीठलाई ललितपुरको मूल बालकुमारी मानिन्छ । पश्चिमाभिमुख गरी स्थापना गरिएको यस पीठमा तामाको छाना हालिएको छ । छानामा धातुका तीनवटा गजूर राखिएका छन् । गजूरलाई धातुको छत्र चढाइएको छ । पीठको छानामा धातुको पताः पनि चढाइएको छ । पीठभित्र बालकुमारीको आकृतिविहीन शिला स्थापना गरिएको छ । उक्त ढुङ्गालाई धातुको तोरण चढाइएको छ । बालकुमारीको शिलापछाडि मातृकाहरू अङ्कित धातुको अर्को तोरण पनि चढाइएको छ । पछाडिको उक्त तोरणको गवाक्षभित्र लिच्छवि चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको छ । पीठभित्र गणेश, वाराही लगायत अन्य मातृकाहरूका आकृतिविहीन शिलाहरू पनि स्थापना गरिएका छन् ।पीठभित्रै बालकुमारीको शिलासँगै उत्तरपट्टि अर्को एउटा शिला रहेको छ । उक्त शिलाको एक भागलाई दशमहाविद्यामध्येकी एक षोडशी मानेर पूजा गरिन्छ । षोडशीलाई त्रिपुरसुन्दरी पनि भनिन्छ । शास्त्रमा लेखिएअनुसार त्रिनेत्र भएको षोडशी लेटिरहेका सदाशिवमाथि रहेको कमलको आसनमाथि विराजमान हुन्छन् र आफ्ना चार हातहरूमा पाश, अंकुश, धनुष र वाण लिएकी हुन्छन् (N. Pokharela 2019, p. 53) । माघ शुक्ल पूर्णिमालाई षोडशीको जन्मदिनको रूपमा मानिन्छ (J. Mānandhara VS 2046, p. 33) । केरा, दाख, बयर आदि फलफूलको साथमा मिठाइ, रातो कपडा राखेर षोडशीको पूजा गरेमा दरिद्रता मोचन हुन्छ भन्ने मान्यता रहेको छ (M. Miśra NS 1127, p. 18) ।बालकुमारीको पीठअगाडि ढलोटको मयूरसहितको ढुङ्गाको स्तम्भ र शङ्खरेश्वर महादेवको शिवलिङ्ग पनि स्थापना गरिएको छ ।बालकुमारी पीठको स्थापनाबारे जानकारी दिने ऐतिहासिक सामग्री पाइएको छैन । पीठभित्र लिच्छविकालीन चैत्य पनि स्थापना गरिएकोले लिच्छविकालमै यस पीठको स्थापना भइसकेको हुनुपर्छ । जनविश्वास अनुसार यी बालकुमारी निकै उग्र थिइन् र बटुवाहरूलाई तर्साउने, बिरामी पारिदिने गर्थिन् । उनको उग्रपनलाई शान्त गर्न सँगै चैत्य स्थापना गरिएको थियो जुन अद्यापि पीठभित्रै देख्न सकिन्छ । यी बालकुमारीलाई थिमिका तान्त्रिकहरूले आफ्नो ठाउँमा लग्न भनी बोकेर लाँदा सुन्धारामा पुगेपछि देवीको शरीरबाट माटो खसेकोले एकछिन बिसाएका थिए । त्यस ठाउँमा पनि बालकुमारीको पीठ (LAL4044-003) स्थापना गरिएको थियो जुन लक्ष्मीनारायण सत: (LAL4044) को अगाडि रहेको छ । त्यसपछि त्यागलमा पुगेपछि त्यहाँ पनि एकपल्ट बिसाइएकोले त्यहाँ पनि बालकुमारीको द्य:छेँ (LAL2140) स्थापना गरिएको थियो । त्यागलबाट क्वाछेँ पुगेपछि भाले बासेकोले ती मानिसहरूले बालकुमारीलाई त्यहीँ छोडेर फर्केका थिए । त्यसपछि क्वाछेँमा बालकुमारीको पीठ स्थापना गरिएको थियो । त्यसै पीठलाई पछि तल्ले शैलीको मन्दिरको रूप दिई बालकुमारी मन्दिर (LAL2000) भन्न थालिएको थियो । ललितपुरको बालकुमारीलाई थिमिमा लग्न असफल भएपछि थिमिका तान्त्रिकहरूले ललितपुरको बालकुमारीको अनुकृति स्वरूप थिमिमा बालकुमारी (THI0010) स्थापना गरेका थिए (Local resident from a Śreṣṭha caste, male, age 62) । अहिले जुन ठाउँमा बालकुमारी पीठ स्थापना गरिएको छ त्यस ठाउँ वरिपरि मृतकको दाहसंस्कार गर्ने मसान पनि थियो । मृतकको दाहसंस्कार गरिसकेपछि खरानी थुपारिने ठाउँलाई अहिले पनि नौद्वँ भनिन्छ जुन बालकुमारी पीठको पूर्वपट्टि रहेको छ । पछि बालकुमारी पीठमा रहेको मसानलाई क्वाछेँमा सारिएको थियो ।पीठमा पाइएको सबैभन्दा पुरानो अभिलेख नेसं ८१७ (सन् १६९६) को शिलापत्र हो । त्यस शिलापत्रमामाहान (सिपाही) बिल्हाम भारोले छोराहरू सिद्धिराम र प्रशुराम (परशुराम), छोरी सरसुति (सरस्वती) लगायत नाति कृष्णरामसँग मिलेर यज्ञ गरेर कुमारी (बालकुमारी) र विघ्नेश्वर (गणेश) को स्थापना गरेको कुरा लेखिएको छ । त्यस मितिभन्दा धेरै पहिले नै बालकुमारी पीठको स्थापना भइसकेकोले उनले पीठको मर्मत गरी विधिपूर्वक पुनः स्थापना गरिदिएको हुनसक्छ । नेसं ८३७ (सन् १७१७) मा यज्ञनारायण भाजु, गंगाधर भारो, धनसिं, चिकुधिक लगायतका व्यक्तिहरूले मिलेर पीठमा एकजोडी ढुङ्गाको सिंह चढाएका थिए । विसं १९५३ (सन् १८९७) मा ललितपुर, चाक बाहाल टोल निवासी सिधिमान श्रेष्ठका छोरा मुखिया पुण्यराजले परिवारका सदस्यहरूसँग मिलेर मयूर सहितको ढुङ्गाको खम्बा र घण्टा चढाएका थिए । विसं १९८१ (सन् १९२५) मा पीठभित्र रहेको गणेशको लागि पित्तलको तोरण चढाइएको थियो । तोरण चढाउँदा राखिएको अभिलेखमा दाताको नाम मेटिसकिएको छ । 10. 2010 - VS 2066 Chaitra 10 Tuesday // NS 1130 Chulathva 8 - Kṣamāpūjā for the construction of shrine - पहिले बाटोमा खुल्ला रूपमा रहेको बालकुमारी पीठलाई पछि छाना राखेर चारैतिरबाट घेरेर सुरक्षित बनाइएको थियो । त्यसो गर्नको लागि विसं २०६६ (सन् २०१०) मा क्षमापूजा गरी काम शुरु गरिएको थियो ।बालकुमारी  पीठमा पुजारी भनी छुट्टै व्यक्ति नियुक्त गरिएको छैन । पीठमा द्यःपाःलाःको रूपमा काम गर्ने शाही थरका व्यक्तिले नै पीठमा नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् । उनले बिहान पीठभित्र सरसफाइ गरी नित्यपूजा पनि गर्छन् ।प्रत्येक शनिवार बिहान धातुबाट बनेको मयूरमा आसीन बालकुमारीको मूर्तिलाई ल्याएर प्रदर्शन गरिन्छ । अन्य दिनमा उक्त मू्र्ति द्यःपाःलाःको घरमा नै राखिन्छ । प्रत्येक वर्ष भाद्र शुक्ल १४ को दिनमा बालकुमारीको जात्रा गरिन्छ । चाबाहाः टोलमा बस्ने महर्जनहरूले उक्त जात्रा सञ्चलान गर्छन् । त्यस दिन बिहान बालकुमारीलाई राँगो बलि दिइन्छ । बेलुकी बालकुमारी, गणेश र वाराहीको धातुको मूर्तिलाई हातमा बोकेर जात्रा गरिन्छ । जात्रा सकिएपछि ती मूर्तिहरू गुठीयारको घरमा नै लगिन्छ ।यस पीठमा स्थापना गरिएकी षोडशी छुट्टै नित्यपूजा गरिन्छ । राजोपाध्याय ब्राह्मणले पीठमा स्थापना गरिएकी षोडशीको नित्यपूजा गरिरहेका छन् । 'दशमहाविद्या भक्तिभाव परिवार' नामक संस्थाले ब्राह्मण पुजारीलाई पारिश्रमिकको व्यवस्था गरिरहेको छ । पहिले षोडशीको नित्यपूजा गर्ने व्यवस्था थिएन । पछि विसं २०८० भाद्र २२ (सन् २०२३) देखि मात्र षोडशीको नित्यपूजा गर्ने काम शुरु गरिएको हो (Priest of Pūrṇacaṇḍī Temple from Rājopādhyāya caste, male, age 74) । प्रत्येक वर्ष कायाष्टमी (भाद्र शुक्ल ८) को दिनमा ललितपुरमा रहेका दशमहाविद्याको पूजा गर्ने कार्यक्रम आयोजना गरिँदा बालकुमारी पीठभित्र स्थापना गरिएकी षोडशीको पनि पूजा गरिन्छ ।

historical_events.event_description: Mahān (soldier) Bilhāma Bhāro, along with his sons Siddhirāma and Praśurāma (Parśurām), daughter Sarasuti (Sarasvatī), and grandson Kṛṣṇarāma, performed a sacrifice (yajña) and established the deities Kumārī (Bālakumārī) and Vighneśvara (Gaṇeśa).

historical_events.event_name: Offering of a pair of stone lions (LAL3010-008, LAL3010-009)
historical_events.event_description: Yajñanārāyaṇa Bhāju, Gaṅgādhara Bhāro, Dhansing, Cikudhik, and others dedicated a pair of stone lions to the shrine.
Puṇyārāja Śreṣṭha, son of Mukhiyā Siddhimāna Śreṣṭha of Cāka Bāhāla, Lalitpur, offered a bell.
Mukhiyā Puṇyārāja Śreṣṭha, son of Siddhimāna Śreṣṭha of Cāka Bāhāla, Lalitpur, offered a stone pillar adorned with a peacock.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of a new statue of peacock
historical_events.event_description: Since the peacock image placed on top of the Peacock Pillar had been stolen, Subbā Puṇyarāja’s son, Kṛṣṇarāja Śreṣṭha, commissioned and installed a new peacock image.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of a brass toraṇa to Gaṇeśa
historical_events.event_description: A brasstoraṇawas offered for the Gaṇeśa shrine inside thepīṭha. The donor’s name has been erased.
Aphaygaṃ(wind chime) that rings with the breeze was installed at the Bālakumārī Pīṭha. The inscription does not mention the donor’s name.

The bell installed by Puṇyarāja Śreṣṭha in 1897 CE (NS 1953) later became damaged. The damaged bell was repaired and reinstalled by Buddhimāyā Tāmrakāra’s sons, Ratnalāla Tāmrakāra and Kīrtilāla Tāmrakāra. Buddhimāyā Tāmrakāra had the bell repaired in memory of her late husband, Miṭhāi Tāmrakāra.

historical_events.event_name: Replacing the wooden pole of the flag
historical_events.event_description: The wooden flagpole at the Bālakumārī Pīṭha had deteriorated, so a new pole was made and installed.

historical_events.event_name: Kṣamāpūjā for the construction of shrine
historical_events.event_description: The Bālakumārī Pīṭha, which was previously open along the roadside, was made secure by adding a roof and enclosing it from all sides. Akṣamāpūjā(penance) was performed before starting the work.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of brass crown to Gaṇeśa
historical_events.event_description: Mantalāla Maharjana, Urumilā (Urmilā) Maharjana, and others collectively offered a brass crown to the Gaṇeśa shrine inside thepīṭha.

historical_events.event_name: Offering of Offering of a pair of metal lions (LAL3010-006, LAL3010-007)
historical_events.event_description: In memory of the late grandfather Jitalāla Tāmrakāra and late grandmother Majjālakṣmī Tāmrakāra, their son Vaśantalāla Tāmrakāra and daughter-in-law Ratnamāyā Tāmrakāra offered a pair of metal lions to the Bālakumārī Pīṭha.
